note: Uncalibrated VLM preview; human scoring remains pending. Image delivery does not establish grading accuracy.

instruction.reason: The central audit mode, local fixture loading, required report IDs/order/classifications, and visible helper overlays work. Verification of independent bounds, spatialAudit helper internals, and transform/invalid-wall recovery was unavailable through the page and forbidden mutation, leaving substantial contract aspects unverified.

interaction.reason: OrbitControls work and refresh is repeatable through the exposed API, but the audit has no page UI. Required visible feedback beyond the colored overlays is implicit, and recovery/invalid-state sequences could not be exercised.

spatial.reason: The building volume, wall geometry, perspective, occlusion, and spatially separated green/red/blue constraint boxes are coherent across three views. Small viewport framing can make the model tiny in empty space, and fresh-bounds behavior after transformation remains unverified.

stability.reason: Initial load, reload, refresh, orbit, and desktop/mobile layouts were reliable. Resource diagnostics were clean apart from favicon 404, and there were no OSM API requests. Unverified transform, missing-wall, and helper-disposal recovery flows preclude a higher rating.

visual.reason: The scene is deliberately minimal but coherent: a neutral gray building, dark background, perspective grid, and strongly differentiated outline colors. The subject is readable, though large empty framing reduces focus.
